notes: The supplied 'it' of 'caused thee to see it' is added: only one suffix stands on the verb and it is rendered by 'thee', so no morpheme licenses the object pronoun (rules 30, 44).
הֶרְאִיתִיךָ heads on 'see', the word carrying the lexeme, not on the light verb 'caused' (rule 44).
שָׁמָּה is one fused unit for 'thither', headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 32).
'This is the land' gives 'This' to the demonstrative and the copula to the predicate noun, discontinuous around the article (rules 20, 25).
